record.original_question: Let G be an infinite r-regular graph, and let h_G(p) denote its p-matching entropy, defined from finite graph approximations G_k by h_G(p) = limsup_{k->infty} log(phi(m_k, G_k)) / |V_k| when 2m_k / |V_k| -> p. If h_{inf K_{r,r}}(p) is the corresponding entropy for a countable disjoint union of copies of K_{r,r}, is it always true that h_G(p) <= h_{inf K_{r,r}}(p) for every p in [0, 1]?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be an infinite $r$-regular graph with a countable vertex set. For a finite graph $H=(V_H,E_H)$ and an integer $m\ge 0$, let $\phi(m,H)$ denote the number of matchings of size $m$ in $H$ (i.e., sets of $m$ pairwise vertex-disjoint edges). Suppose $G$ is exhausted by an increasing sequence of finite induced subgraphs $G_k=(V_k,E_k)$ with $|V_k|\to\infty$. For each $p\in[0,1]$, define the $p$-matching entropy of $G$ by
$$h_G(p)\;=\;\limsup_{k\to\infty}\;\frac{\log \phi(m_k,G_k)}{|V_k|},$$
where $(m_k)$ is any sequence of nonnegative integers with $2m_k/|V_k|\to p$ (the value being taken as the supremum over such sequences).

Let $K_{r,r}$ denote the complete bipartite graph with $r+r$ vertices, and let $\infty K_{r,r}$ denote the disjoint union of countably many copies of $K_{r,r}$, with its corresponding $p$-matching entropy $h_{\infty K_{r,r}}(p)$.

Prove or disprove: for every infinite $r$-regular graph $G$ and every $p\in[0,1]$,
$$h_G(p)\;\le\;h_{\infty K_{r,r}}(p).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The finite version (Upper Matching Conjecture of Friedland–Krop–Markström) was proved for all sufficiently large d-regular bipartite graphs by Davies, Jenssen, Perkins, and Roberts (arXiv:2004.06695, JCTB 2021), and asymptotic bounds were given by Ilinca–Kahn (2013). However, the full asymptotic upper matching conjecture for arbitrary infinite r-regular graphs and all densities p ∈ [0,1] does not appear to be fully resolved; only partial/asymptotic and large-graph results are confirmed.

status_evidence.title: A proof of the Upper Matching Conjecture for large graphs
status_evidence.snippet: For every d and every large enough n divisible by 2d, a union of n/(2d) copies of K_{d,d} maximizes the number of matchings of size k.
status_evidence.claim: The finite UMC is proved for sufficiently large regular graphs, supporting (but not fully establishing for all infinite G and all p) the asymptotic version.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics of the Upper Matching Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Ilinca and Kahn give upper bounds matching the conjecture asymptotically.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotic upper bounds toward AUMC are established.

status_evidence.title: On the Validations of the Asymptotic Matching Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of validations of the asymptotic matching conjectures including AUMC.
status_evidence.claim: AUMC is discussed as a conjecture with partial validations.
